candidates.change_summary: Move the state reset rewardsForA[recipient] = 0; to after the external call so that the balance is cleared only after the external call succeeds/fails (changes reentrancy/rollback behavior).
Remove the state reset rewardsForA[recipient] = 0; so the stored reward remains after withdrawal (changing observable balance across calls).
Set the stored reward to a different value (1) after reading, so the state after withdraw differs from original (instead of zeroing it, set to 1).
Remove the line that clears _locked after function execution, leaving _locked permanently true after first use and changing future observable behavior of withdrawReward (modifier state persists).
Move the setting of _locked = false to before the guarded call (releasing the lock early), altering possible reentrant interactions and thus observable post-call state.

Move the line that sets claimedBonus[recipient] = true to before withdrawReward(recipient), causing the bonus-claimed flag to be set prior to the external call and changing observable state if withdrawReward reverts or behaves differently.
Remove the line that marks the bonus as claimed, leaving claimedBonus[recipient] unchanged and so observable state after the call differs (claimedBonus remains false).
Change the increment to not add the bonus (set to add 0 instead of 100), so rewardsForA and thus funds withdrawn differ after the call.
Swap the order so withdrawReward is called before increasing rewardsForA, causing no bonus to be withdrawn during the call and changing observable balances.
Change the require to check claimedBonus[recipient] is true (invert the guard), allowing the function to run only if already claimed and changing observable effect.
